native_dependencies.download_requires: GitHub Actions artifact access through the connected GitHub tool or authenticated GitHub CLI; UTM_SYSROOT_ZIP also accepts a downloaded archive.

license: UTM frontend Apache-2.0; QEMU, SPICE and other components retain their respective upstream licenses. The build preserves UTM's bundled notices and native dependency documentation.
scope: A separate complete UTM iOS reference app; this does not embed QEMU or arbitrary .utm execution into WindowsiOS.
compatibility: Current pinned frontend is compiled against the official v5.0.8 native sysroot. Source/signature verification does not establish guest runtime compatibility. Apple Virtualization.framework macOS guests remain macOS-host-only; iPad macOS work uses the separate Henge software engine.
